findings.title: NPE still possible in getSubGroupsStream overloads for deleted groups
findings.body: The fix adds a null check only in getSubGroupsCount(), but the three getSubGroupsStream(...) overloads (lines 254-269) call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) with no null guard. When a group is concurrently deleted, modelSupplier.get() (cacheSession.getGroupDelegate().getGroupById) returns null and these methods will throw a NullPointerException — the exact class of failure this PR is meant to fix. The same concurrent-delete scenario exercised by the new test (listing groups while deleting them) can hit these paths via other admin endpoints, so the NPE is only partially fixed.

findings.title: getSubGroupsCount now returns null for a deleted group, inconsistent with other methods
findings.body: When the underlying group no longer exists, getSubGroupsCount() returns null, whereas other adapter methods (e.g. isUpdated(), getDelegateForUpdate()) throw IllegalStateException("Not found in database") and the GroupModel contract otherwise returns a Long count. Callers such as GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount will silently put a null subGroupCount into the GroupRepresentation, producing JSON with a null field instead of an error or 0, which may surprise API clients. Consider throwing the same IllegalStateException or returning 0 for consistency.

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined; assertion can pass before concurrent reads finish
findings.body: In createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti(), the background reader thread is started but never joined. After deletedAll.set(true), the test immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty while the reader may still be mid-request or not yet have observed the flag. The test can pass even if an exception would be thrown one iteration later, making it flaky/ineffective at reproducing the race it targets. The thread reference should be kept and joined (with a timeout) before asserting. Also, the non-daemon thread risks leaking if the busy loop ever blocks.

findings.title: Unbounded busy-loop hammering the admin endpoint in test
findings.body: The reader thread loops without any sleep, issuing groups(null, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, true) requests back-to-back until all 100 deletes complete. This creates heavy load and log noise in CI and can slow the deleting thread, arbitrarily extending test duration. A small pause between iterations (and a bounded max iteration count) would make the test more deterministic and less wasteful.
